style.styleTitle: Personalised Christmas LED Candle Bauble by PMC
style.toneOfVoice: Our beautiful personalised glass bauble features a flickering LED Candle inside perfect for remembering a loved one at Christmas. The bauble comes ready to hang straight on the Christmas tree and will be sure to add some festive sparkle. You can personalise this bauble with a name up to 12 characters. Please note that all personalisation is case sensitive and will appear as entered. Please avoid entering the name in block capitals, as this may make the personalisation difficult to read. Please note these are handmade so there may be some slight imperfections such as small water marks due to the manufacturing process. Includes 1 x CR2032 Battery.
